# Functions vendored from the reference's package-map source: the import-target
# resolver and exactly what it calls there, plus the namespace-map builders that
# produce one of its inputs from extraction results.
#
# Determined by a call-graph walk over the pinned reference, not by reading; see
# docs/plan/ISSUES.md, issue 15. Manifest scanning and package discovery in the same
# source are deliberately absent. The list names upstream functions, so it is this
# vendoring step's input and is excluded from the provenance scan.
#
# One function name per line. Extracted verbatim, in the order the source defines them.

header Vendored subset: the import-target resolver and what it calls, extracted
header verbatim from the reference's package-map source by
header scripts/vendor/extract-functions.py. The rest of that source, which scans
header manifests and discovers packages, is deliberately not here.

# Includes the source carries only for the manifest scanning that is not extracted.
# The resolver needs none of them: the one thing it takes from discovery, the
# language of a file name, is declared by the shim's pipeline header.
drop-include discover/discover.h
drop-include foundation/win_utf8.h
drop-include foundation/yaml.h

# The source's includes for its filesystem, platform and JSON work, which serve the
# manifest scanning left behind; none of the functions above use them.
drop-include foundation/compat_fs.h
drop-include foundation/platform.h
drop-include foundation/log.h
drop-include yyjson/yyjson.h
drop-include sys/stat.h
